<h3>Palmares</h3>
<p>
<h4>Before World War II</h4>
<pre>
year     winners         runners-up        venue
<a href="#29">1929/31</a>  Romania         Yugoslavia        home and away matches
<a href="#31">1931</a>     Bulgaria        Turkey            Bulgaria
<a href="#32">1932</a>     Bulgaria        Yugoslavia        Yugoslavia
<a href="#33">1933</a>     Romania         Yugoslavia        Romania
<a href="#34">1934/35</a>  Yugoslavia      Greece            Greece
<a href="#35">1935</a>     Bulgaria [*]    Yugoslavia        Bulgaria
<a href="#36">1936</a>     Romania         Bulgaria          Romania

[*] Bulgaria were declared winners in April 1936; at the tournament itself,
    Yugoslavia had been handed the trophy (see <a href="#35">explanations below</a>).
</pre>
